scope: Group danger posture native task footprint
implementation: Check every living member before group-wide danger behaviour/combat-mode application and exact restoration. Mounted, nonlocal, player, care, flight, captive/incapacitated, stealth/careless and held-fire members refuse the write.
Ordinary travel and CBE manoeuvre remain eligible. Maximum64 members; larger groups refuse instead of sampling. No new worker or native command.
Pending restoration retains its original receipt and expiry; changed native components retire without an unnecessary footprint check.
limits: Audits paused; no Arma launch. Physical native timing, mixed-role behaviour, HC and performance unverified.
This covers DangerReact group-mode writes, not every group writer or per-member baseline restoration.
No source parity or buildout percentage rescore. Protected sources and unrelated dirt preserved.
